core.share.title: Share “{title}”
core.share.help: The recipients get a notification in the wiki and an e-mail. Sharing does not change permissions: whoever may not see the page is not notified.
core.share.users_help: Type at least 2 letters and choose from the list; add several one after the other.
core.share.without_access: Not notified, because they may not see the page: {names}
core.share.none: Please choose at least one person, group or role.
perm.core.share.use_help: Notify users, groups and roles about a page or category they may see.
